patch.text: Identification: bare 'pippalī' is long pepper (Piper longum; standard). Here, in the chapter on madana, the 'pippalīs' drawn out of the dried fruits and called 'phalapippalī' in the next units are probably the dried madana fruit pieces themselves (the commentators' reading, as far as I recall; probable, not certain), so 'long pepper' is not put in the translation. 'palala' is ground sesame paste in some references (kept as the name palala).
